kit_bread_maker.name: Bread maker
kit_bread_maker.flavor: Wakes the house at six with a smell and a thud.

kit_slow_cooker.name: Slow cooker
kit_slow_cooker.flavor: Put it on before work. Come home to the same stew as last week.

kit_rice_cooker.name: Rice cooker
kit_rice_cooker.flavor: Clicks to warm and stays smug about it.

kit_citrus_juicer.name: Citrus juicer
kit_citrus_juicer.flavor: Half a lemon, and most of it on the counter.

kit_sandwich_toaster.name: Sandwich toaster
kit_sandwich_toaster.flavor: Molten cheese at the temperature of the sun.

kit_deep_fat_fryer.name: Deep fat fryer
kit_deep_fat_fryer.flavor: Kept for chips. Smells of chips. Forever.

kit_ice_cream_maker.name: Ice cream maker
kit_ice_cream_maker.flavor: Made vanilla once, in 2016. Still talked about.

kit_pasta_machine.name: Pasta machine
kit_pasta_machine.flavor: Flour in the rollers since the first attempt.

kit_mincer.name: Hand mincer
kit_mincer.flavor: Clamped to the table, cranked by the youngest.

kit_colander.name: Enamel colander
kit_colander.flavor: Drains the peas and half the peas.

kit_flour_sifter.name: Flour sifter
kit_flour_sifter.flavor: Squeak, squeak, a cloud, a cough.

kit_rolling_pin_board.name: Rolling pin and pastry board
kit_rolling_pin_board.flavor: Pastry for one pie, flour for the whole kitchen.

kit_egg_timer.name: Sand egg timer
kit_egg_timer.flavor: Three minutes, or two if you shake it.

kit_kitchen_timer.name: Wind-up kitchen timer
kit_kitchen_timer.flavor: Rings loud enough to burn the toast anyway.

kit_cheese_dome.name: Cheese dome
kit_cheese_dome.flavor: Keeps the cheese in and the smell mostly in.

kit_butter_dish.name: Butter dish
kit_butter_dish.flavor: The butter is always hard. That is the deal.

kit_gravy_boat.name: Gravy boat
kit_gravy_boat.flavor: Comes out at Christmas and on no other day.

kit_soup_tureen.name: Soup tureen
kit_soup_tureen.flavor: For soup, in theory. Holds the good napkins.

kit_roasting_tin.name: Roasting tin with a chicken
kit_roasting_tin.flavor: Sunday lunch, at least an hour late.

kit_wok.name: Wok
kit_wok.flavor: Seasoned, the owner says. Rusty, says everyone else.

kit_skillet.name: Cast-iron skillet
kit_skillet.flavor: Weighs as much as a small dog. Never washed with soap.

kit_steamer_baskets.name: Bamboo steamer
kit_steamer_baskets.flavor: Three tiers of dumplings, one tier of good intentions.

kit_tagine.name: Tagine
kit_tagine.flavor: Brought back in hand luggage. Never again.

kit_fondue_set.name: Fondue set
kit_fondue_set.flavor: Seventies wedding present, rediscovered every decade.

kit_moka_pot.name: Stovetop espresso pot
kit_moka_pot.flavor: Gurgles like a drain, tastes like Italy, roughly.

kit_cup_and_saucer.name: Cup and saucer
kit_cup_and_saucer.flavor: Bone china, for the vicar and nobody else.

kit_egg_cups.name: Egg cups
kit_egg_cups.flavor: Three cups, three eggs, one with a face drawn on.

kit_toast_rack.name: Toast rack
kit_toast_rack.flavor: Keeps toast cold, as tradition demands.

kit_pestle_mortar.name: Pestle and mortar
kit_pestle_mortar.flavor: Granite. Could stop a door, or a burglar.

kit_kitchen_roll_holder.name: Kitchen roll holder
kit_kitchen_roll_holder.flavor: Always on the last few sheets.

kit_washing_up_bowl.name: Washing-up bowl
kit_washing_up_bowl.flavor: A spoon has lived at the bottom since March.

kit_pan_rail.name: Pan rail with utensils
kit_pan_rail.flavor: Everything to hand, and all of it banging together.

kit_knife_strip.name: Magnetic knife strip
kit_knife_strip.flavor: Sharp knives, kept just above eye level. Sensible.

kit_chalkboard.name: Kitchen chalkboard
kit_chalkboard.flavor: MILK, written three times in three hands.

kit_key_hooks.name: Key hooks
kit_key_hooks.flavor: Four hooks, and the keys are in yesterday's coat.

kit_oven_gloves.name: Oven gloves on a hook
kit_oven_gloves.flavor: Scorched on the thumb that matters.

kit_apron_peg.name: Apron on a peg
kit_apron_peg.flavor: Clean. Worn twice a year for photographs.

kit_extractor_hood.name: Extractor hood
kit_extractor_hood.flavor: Loud, and moves the steam around a bit.

kit_wall_cupboard.name: Wall cupboard
kit_wall_cupboard.flavor: Top shelf: the fondue forks and a mystery lid.

kit_shopping_trolley.name: Shopping trolley bag
kit_shopping_trolley.flavor: Tartan, with a wheel that pulls left.

kit_step_stool.name: Folding step stool
kit_step_stool.flavor: For the top cupboard and nothing else, ever.

kit_recycling_crates.name: Recycling crates
kit_recycling_crates.flavor: Sorted with religious care, collected on the wrong day.

kit_washing_machine.name: Washing machine
kit_washing_machine.flavor: Walks across the floor on the spin cycle.

kit_tumble_dryer.name: Tumble dryer
kit_tumble_dryer.flavor: Shrinks one jumper per year, as a tithe.

kit_dishwasher.name: Dishwasher
kit_dishwasher.flavor: Loaded wrong, according to everyone else.

kit_chest_freezer.name: Chest freezer
kit_chest_freezer.flavor: Peas from the last century at the bottom.

kit_larder_cupboard.name: Larder cupboard
kit_larder_cupboard.flavor: Tins arranged by date, then by panic.

kit_welsh_dresser.name: Welsh dresser
kit_welsh_dresser.flavor: Every plate on show and none of them used.

kit_settle_bench.name: Kitchen settle
kit_settle_bench.flavor: Hard as a church pew, and about as old.

kit_milk_churn.name: Milk churn
kit_milk_churn.flavor: From a farm, allegedly. Holds umbrellas now.

kit_belfast_sink.name: Belfast sink on legs
kit_belfast_sink.flavor: Deep enough to bath a spaniel. It has.

kit_lunchbox.name: Lunchbox
kit_lunchbox.flavor: A sandwich, a satsuma and a note nobody reads.

kit_sugar_bowl.name: Sugar bowl and tongs
kit_sugar_bowl.flavor: Lumps, for the one aunt who still takes them.

kit_popcorn_maker.name: Popcorn maker
kit_popcorn_maker.flavor: Film night, and the smoke alarm joins in.

kit_milk_crate.name: Crate of milk bottles
kit_milk_crate.flavor: Gold top on Fridays. Somebody insists.

kit_herb_trough.name: Windowsill herb trough
kit_herb_trough.flavor: Basil, dying slowly and in public.

kit_baking_trays.name: Baking trays and a muffin tin
kit_baking_trays.flavor: Blackened in a way no scourer will touch.

kit_cooling_rack.name: Cooling rack with biscuits
kit_cooling_rack.flavor: Biscuits cooling, and vanishing one at a time.

kit_cake_carrier.name: Cake carrier
kit_cake_carrier.flavor: Arrives at the fete with a dent in the icing.

kit_jelly_mould.name: Jelly on a plate
kit_jelly_mould.flavor: Wobbles when anyone walks past. Everyone walks past.

kit_lazy_susan.name: Lazy Susan with sauces
kit_lazy_susan.flavor: Spun for fun, sauce flies off the side.

kit_pie_dish.name: Pie in an enamel dish
kit_pie_dish.flavor: Steak and kidney, with a bird in the middle for the steam.

kit_jam_pan.name: Jam pan and jars
kit_jam_pan.flavor: Plum jam for the whole street, labelled in biro.

kit_mixing_bowl.name: Mixing bowl with whisk
kit_mixing_bowl.flavor: Cake mix, licked from the spoon by committee.

kit_box_grater.name: Box grater and cheese
kit_box_grater.flavor: Takes a knuckle with every block of cheddar.

kit_veg_rack.name: Three-tier vegetable rack
kit_veg_rack.flavor: Onions at the bottom, sprouting quietly.

kit_potato_sack.name: Sack of potatoes
kit_potato_sack.flavor: Twenty-five kilos, bought in a fit of thrift.

kit_garlic_string.name: Strings of garlic and chillies
kit_garlic_string.flavor: Wards off vampires and most visitors.

kit_herb_drying_rack.name: Herb drying rack
kit_herb_drying_rack.flavor: Bunches of thyme that crumble when looked at.
